//: The OFFICE application, hosted. A SECOND Vercel project on the same
repository — the first one deploys the mobile app from the repo root's
vercel.json, and the two must not fight over it.
To use it: create a new Vercel project pointed at this repository, and in
Project → Settings → General set the Configuration File to
deploy/vercel-desk.json. Then set, under Environment Variables:
VITE_DESK_HOST   the address of the API this build talks to — the
Python service (cloud-python), or a school's own host
reachable from the internet. Leave it unset only if
Everything else is the same build the school's own computer serves.
There is no separate source and no separate application.
